target: Stand up and verify the Gate-0C live exemplar set on the operator host: purge the dNh_CRM ledger contamination (using the TP-0021 tool), recreate the mvp dope-memory container with correct identity env (removing the leaked DOPE_MEMORY_WORKSPACE_ID=dNh_CRM), fulfill or release the unfulfilled per-worktree lease (3054) by starting a per-worktree dope-memory sidecar for the active DCP worktree via the proven compose-override path, restore mcp-conport_dnh_crm_8d6d to healthy, and reconcile runtime-registry hygiene (release ~30 stale test leases, register the 5 unregistered live containers, resolve the 6 conflicting task-orchestrator identity claims on port 7890).
invariants: One public MCP endpoint; no backend ports exposed; no backend writes; no lifecycle mutations from the facade.
target_id is the only caller-facing handle; callers never supply paths, URLs, ports, workspace IDs, or runtime selectors.
Runtime discovery never grants exposure; port leases never prove ownership; heuristics may discover but never authorize; ambiguity blocks; cross-repo mounts block.
A skipped live gate is NOT a pass (ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md proof rule); never rewrite a historical PARTIAL/SKIPPED verdict - append new evidence.
Proof must be current to the exact head SHA (scripts/audit/exact_head_readiness.py contract).
STOP IF: the embedded auditor returns FAIL or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.
Operator-supervised host mutations only; every container recreate/stop is listed in the plan and receipted; no data deleted without the TP-0021 export-quarantine receipt.
Lease and registry mutations go through dopemux mcp tooling (doctor/repair/reconcile), never hand-edited JSON.
Reserved singleton semantics: the 7890 identity conflict is resolved by identity evidence, not by lease assignment.
Exemplar acceptance = all three: absolute per-worktree .dopemux mount, matching runtime identity, no cross-repo state (post-purge verification query included in proof).
STOP IF: purge receipts are missing or a recreate would destroy unexported state.

pr.title: proof(mcp): Gate-0C live exemplar - clean per-worktree dope-memory + registry hygiene
pr.body:
Executes the Gate-0C remediation list from the 2026-07-17 ops snapshot: contamination purge (TP-0021 tool), mvp identity fix, per-worktree sidecar stand-up for the DCP worktree, conport sidecar health restore, and runtime-registry/lease hygiene. Delivers the live exemplar proof required before any live facade acceptance.

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links

steps.task: Execute in order with receipts: (1) TP-0021 purge on /Users/hue/code/dNh_CRM/.dopemux/chronicle.sqlite (dry-run, review, --apply); (2) fix the mvp stack env source leaking DOPE_MEMORY_WORKSPACE_ID=dNh_CRM and recreate dopemux-dope-memory-1 with correct mvp identity; (3) dopemux mcp start for the active DCP worktree to stand up its per-worktree dope-memory (fulfilling or releasing lease 3054); (4) restore mcp-conport_dnh_crm_8d6d health; (5) registry hygiene via dopemux mcp doctor/repair: release stale pytest/synthetic leases, register live containers, reconcile 7890 identity dirs.
requirements: Post-purge verification query shows zero cross-workspace rows in the dNh_CRM ledger.
docker inspect shows correct identity env + absolute .dopemux mount for every dope-memory sidecar.
instances.json registers all live sidecars; port-leases.json has no stale active test leases.
Exactly one authoritative 7890 identity claim remains, matching the live container.
expected_files: proof/TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0022/** (doctor json, docker snapshots, purge receipts, before/after registry diffs)
validation: No files outside commit.allowlist are modified; change matches the stated scope.

steps.task: Run the packet validation commands and inspect the diff/evidence.
validation: Exemplar passes all three Gate-0C conditions (mount, identity, no cross-repo state) with evidence in proof.
No unexported data was destroyed (receipts present).
Doctor reports consistent registry state (no stale-active leases, no identity conflicts).

steps.task: Produce the proof bundle under proof/TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0022/ (PROOF.json, COMMAND_LOG.md, AUDITOR_REPORT.md) with embedded_audit conforming to schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json, and record PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN buckets honestly (NOT_RUN never collapsed into PASS).
requirements: COMMAND_LOG.md with outputs and exit codes.
validation: python3 scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py passes on the new PROOF.json.
Embedded audit verdict recorded (PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks).
